Name: Storage Containers
Author: trashcan9
Description:
The added items are rebalanced/tweaked/working versions from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7539]Alternate Storage[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7807]6480's Storage Variety[/url]. Those mods are no longer needed with this mod as their items are included.

Each container has different [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9791]Better Chests[/url] features e.g. the larger containers (on the list, Wooden Cabinet and below) cannot be carried when they have items inside (i.e. the Better Chests mod's CarryChest flag is Disabled), while the smaller containers can be carried when they contain items and some even opened while carried (e.g. the Small Storage Bin and Adventurer's Pack). The added storage containers are:

[list]
[*]Keepsake Box: 12 capacity
[*]Adventurer's Pack: 12 capacity, adventurer loot only, carried and opened from inventory
[*]Small Storage Bin: 12 capacity, can be opened from inventory
[*]Small Cardboard Box: 24 capacity
[*]Small Wooden Crate: 24 capacity
[*]Small Wooden Barrel: 24 capacity
[*]Cardboard Box: 36 capacity
[*]Wooden Crate: 36 capacity
[*]Ice Cooler: 48 capacity, food only, can be opened from inventory
[*]Wooden Barrel: 48 capacity
[*]Wooden Cabinet: 48 capacity
[*]Storage Locker: 60 capacity
[*]Lumber Pile: 72 capacity, resources only
[*]Walk-in Cooler: 72 capacity, food only
[*]Mini Storage Shed: 84 capacity
[*]Wrought-iron Cellar: 96 capacity
[/list]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download and install the mods listed under Requirements above.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
[list]
[*]Some recipes are known by default.
[*]Some recipes can be purchased at various vendors, primarily from the carpenter shop.
[*]Some recipes are learned via skill ups.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. If there are issues, please report them.
[*]Compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url] mod. Most recipes should be sorted into Machinery tab by default.
[*]Compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9791]Better Chests[/url] mod. All the containers make use of Better Chests features.
[/list]

[size=5]Configuration[/size]
[list]
[*]Storage containers can be disabled via configuration using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] or editing config.json directly in the mod folder.
[/list]

[size=5]Known Issues[/size]
[list]
[*]The Ice Cooler and Walk-in Cooler should function as mini-fridges, but don't currently due to an issue in the Expanded Storage mod.
[*]When receiving a recipe on the level-up screen, the wrong sprites are displayed. This is currently an issue in Expanded Storage mod.
[/list]

[size=5]Other Recommended Mods[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14403]Out-and-About Storage[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4089]Chests and Pouches[/url]
[/list]
